ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Open Seminar
ns2:course.description: Experimental course on a special topic in agricultural and consumer economics. Topic may not be repeated except in accordance with the Code. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated up to 5 hours in a semester, to a maximum of 12 hours.
